_note: W-0251. How each gate under deploy/ci/scripts/ is actually run. gate-sweep.mjs executes every entry that has an `argv`, and requires the `expect` token in the output -- exit 0 alone is not a verdict, because most of these print a usage line and several print a report whose own verdict field says FAIL. Entries without `argv` are classified explicitly, with a reason, so the sweep can assert that every file in the directory is accounted for. That last property is the point: `external-decision-response-validator` and `external-decision-closure-validator` were red from W-0217 to W-0250 because nothing ran them and nothing noticed they had no runner.

_fields.argv: arguments after the script path; [] means the bare invocation is the read-only one
_fields.expect: substring that must appear in stdout+stderr for the run to count as a pass
_fields.sweepable: false with a reason, for gates a static offline sweep cannot run
_fields.runner: what does run it, when the sweep does not

api-behavior-matrix-selftest.mjs.reason: asserts on verify-api-behavior-matrix, whose verdict depends on the ApiBehaviorMatrixTests run having happened against current source

api-behavior-matrix.mjs.reason: drives the HTTP matrix and writes .artifacts/api-matrix; a generator, not a gate

build-api-docs.mjs.reason: regenerates docs/api; a generator whose output docs-selftest.mjs checks

check-mr-traceability.mjs.reason: reads the merge-request description, which exists only in a merge_request_event pipeline

generate-oasdiff-changelog.sh.reason: needs the pinned tufin/oasdiff image and three path arguments; a generator

generate-speech-segments.mjs.reason: writes speech segments; a generator, not a gate
generate-speech-segments.mjs.runner: invoked by hand when the speech bank changes

image-selftest.mjs.reason: runs docker build against the UI and API images

k8s-selftest.mjs.reason: needs helm, kubeconform and a running cluster; exceeds any offline budget

migration-expand-guard.mjs.reason: a library with no top-level invocation; running it directly exits 0 having proved nothing

observability-runtime-selftest.mjs.reason: a library with no top-level invocation; running it directly exits 0 having proved nothing

regenerate-openapi.ps1.reason: PowerShell codegen driver for NSwag; a generator, and openapi-contract-drift.mjs is the gate on its output
regenerate-openapi.ps1.runner: invoked by hand after an OAS edit

render-fixed-speech.mjs.reason: needs --endpoint, --output and --acceptance; renders audio against a live TTS endpoint

render-voice-audition.mjs.reason: needs --output and a TTS endpoint or container

scan-pii.sh.reason: the scanner itself, run over a path; selftest-pii.sh is the gate that proves it rejects

security-scan.sh.reason: needs the scanner images and a network; selftest-dotnet-policy.sh covers the policy half offline

selftest-oasdiff.sh.reason: needs the oasdiff binary, which lives in the pinned image and not on a developer host

tts-voice-acceptance-lib.mjs.reason: a library with no top-level invocation

verify-api-behavior-matrix.mjs.reason: its verdict is `Source changed since the HTTP matrix ran` until ApiBehaviorMatrixTests runs again, so a static sweep would report a stale artefact as a broken gate
verify-api-behavior-matrix.mjs.runner: after dotnet test, in the same lap
